SculptSoft's co-founders are Prashant Thakkar (Co-Founder & CEO) and Arpit Makhiyaviya (Co-Founder & CTO).
Established in 2012, SculptSoft is a leading custom software development company dedicated to empowering businesses with the latest technology. The team of 120+ experienced professionals specializes in creating tailored software applications, including custom web app development, mobile app development, gen AI development, AI/ML development, staff augmentation and offshore outsourcing.
